name: manual_0d046c
claim: When harmonizing a Proposed shared standard into a repo, supplement the existing routing policy (fallback, alternate paths, gates) and refresh only outdated ids; define any transition rule once with a checkable trigger and link to it, never restate it or phrase it circularly.

decisions.notes: orama-system PR 381 first replaced the canonical tier policy; the operator reverted that scope, and the circular 'once the mechanism exists' wording had to be replaced by two checkable conditions (2026-10-24).
